Help Center Advisor

Structure and content strategy for the STA help center.

What it is

A Cowork assistant that manages the structure and content strategy for STA's Salesforce Knowledge help center - auditing articles, finding coverage gaps by product, flagging duplicates, and delivering ranked, actionable recommendations. It is the strategy layer above the Help Center Article skill, which does the actual writing.

What it does - eight task types

  • Article audit, product category audit, and full help-center audit.
  • Gap analysis by product and duplicate detection.
  • Article improvement suggestions (line-level edits).
  • Priority ranking ("what to work on first").
  • HC Index App maintenance.

Audits run across three orthogonal dimensions: KCS v6 four-field structure, an 18-criterion density-and-voice checklist, and an 18-criterion RAG-readiness checklist for AI retrieval.

Hard rules. Every recommendation is ranked by impact tier (Critical → High → Medium → Low) - never a flat list. No archive recommendation without a stated reason and the disposition of inbound links.

What it does not do

  • Does not write or format articles → Help Center Article skill.
  • Does not archive, delete, or unpublish - it provides rationale; Adam takes the action.
  • Does not change Salesforce taxonomy, data categories, or topics → that is SF admin work for Kelsey Eberly.

How to access it

Lives in Adam's Cowork workspace. Cowork-only.
